_comment: FAQ content. Edit this file to add, remove or update questions without touching any HTML.

items.questionEn: How far in advance should I book?
items.answerEn: We recommend booking at least 3–5 days in advance, especially for weekends. For same-week availability, send a message directly — spots sometimes open up.
items.answerZh: 建议至少提前3至5天预约，尤其是周末。如需当周预约，可直接发送消息询问 — 有时会有临时空位。

items.questionEn: Can I bring a design reference photo?
items.answerEn: Absolutely — bringing a reference photo is encouraged! You can send it ahead of time through Instagram or 小红书 so we can discuss it and prepare any special materials.
items.answerZh: 当然可以！非常欢迎您带参考图。您可以提前通过 Instagram 或小红书发送参考图，这样我们可以事先沟通并准备所需材料。

items.answerEn: Please provide at least 24 hours notice if you need to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations (less than 24 hours) may result in a deposit forfeiture.
items.answerZh: 如需取消或改期，请至少提前24小时通知。晚于24小时的取消可能导致定金不予退还。

items.answerEn: Please let us know if you expect to be more than 10 minutes late. Arrivals more than 15 minutes late may need to be rescheduled to avoid affecting other appointments.
items.answerZh: 如预计迟到超过10分钟，请提前告知我们。迟到超过15分钟可能需要重新安排预约时间，以免影响其他客户。

items.answerEn: Yes, free street parking is available near the studio. The exact address is provided after booking is confirmed.
items.answerZh: 是的，工作室附近有免费路边停车位。预约确认后将提供详细地址。

items.questionEn: Are there pets in the home studio?
items.questionZh: 家庭工作室里有宠物吗？
items.answerEn: There are no pets in the studio space. Please let us know in advance if you have any allergies or sensitivities.
items.answerZh: 工作室空间内没有宠物。如您有任何过敏或特殊需求，请提前告知。

items.questionZh: 你们支持哪些语言服务？
items.answerEn: We communicate comfortably in both English and Mandarin Chinese (普通话). Our website is also available in both languages.
items.answerZh: 我们可以用英语和普通话进行流畅沟通，网站同样支持中英双语。

items.questionEn: Do you offer custom nail art?
items.questionZh: 你们提供定制美甲图案吗？
items.answerEn: Yes! Custom nail art is our specialty. Bring any reference image and we'll work together to create something you love.
items.answerZh: 是的！定制美甲图案是我们的专长。请带上您喜欢的参考图，我们将共同打造您心仪的美甲。

items.answerEn: Yes, we offer professional removal of previous gel, acrylic, or dip powder sets. Please mention this when booking as it adds time to the appointment.
items.answerZh: 是的，我们提供专业卸除光疗胶、水晶甲或浸粉甲的服务。预约时请注明，因为卸甲需要额外时间。

items.questionEn: Should I tell you about nail allergies or nail problems?
items.questionZh: 如果我有美甲产品过敏或指甲问题，需要提前告知吗？
items.answerEn: Yes. Tell us before booking if you have previously reacted to gel, acrylic, nail glue, dip powder, or other nail products. Services should be postponed if there are open cuts, sores, significant inflammation, or signs of a nail or skin infection. A nail technician cannot diagnose or treat a medical condition.
items.answerZh: 需要。如果您曾对光疗胶、水晶甲、美甲胶水、浸粉或其他美甲产品产生过敏反应，请在预约前告知我们。如有开放性伤口、皮肤破损、明显炎症，或疑似指甲或皮肤感染，应暂缓服务。美甲师无法诊断或治疗医疗问题。
